body:
## Problem

A durable agent that runs in the native chat runtime (Claude Agent SDK / stream-json, Codex app-server, Copilot ACP) on a satellite desktop cannot be viewed or operated from a controller desktop over Annex. The controller treats every remote agent as a terminal agent, and a chat agent has no PTY, so the user gets an empty terminal with no explanation. Most control messages the controller sends (`pty:input`, `agent:kill`) land on the PTY manager and do nothing for a chat agent.

The satellite side is partly there already: it broadcasts `chat:event`, reports `executionMode: 'chat'` in the snapshot, pushes chat status (#2211), mirrors chat permissions into the Annex queue, and has an HTTP message route that reaches the chat runtime. The controller side has none of the plumbing.

All file:line references are on `origin/main` at `91da2bc6`.

## Current state

| Area | State | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Status / "Needs you" for a remote chat agent | Works | `agent:status` push (#2211), `annex-server.ts:281-312`; `ChromeSidebar.tsx:420-423` merges remote needs |
| Snapshot says the agent runs in chat | Works (unused) | `annex-server.ts:540` sends `executionMode`; controller spreads it into the agent at `remoteProjectStore.ts:283` but nothing reads it |
| Wake / sleep detection | Works | wake goes through `spawnAgent`, which starts chat by the satellite's settings (`agent-system.ts:405-453`); chat exit emits `pty:exit` via `broadcastAgentExit` (`chat-spawn.ts:580`) |
| Group-project inject / shoulder tap | Works | `annex-server.ts:2004-2009` calls `runtime.sendMessage` for non-PTY runtimes |
| Pane rendering | Broken | `AgentRuntimePane.tsx:98`, `:203`, `:226` force the terminal for any remote project |
| Live chat events on the controller | Missing | `annex-client.ts:633-636` forwards `chat:event` only through `default:`; `annexClientStore.ts:350-428` has no `chat:event` branch |
| Transcript backfill on connect / reconnect | Missing | no chat transcript route; controller never sends `replay` (no `replay` in `annex-client.ts`) |
| Typing / sending | Broken | `pty:input` → `ptyManager.write` (`annex-server.ts:2296`), which returns when there is no PTY session (`pty-manager.ts:549-551`) |
| Stop / sleep from a controller or iOS | Broken (#2394) | `agent:kill` → `ptyManager.gracefulKill` (`annex-server.ts:2379-2388`), no-op without a PTY (`pty-manager.ts:624-626`) |
| Delete a running chat agent remotely | Broken | `annex-server.ts:1794` only stops PTY/headless agents before deleting |
| Interrupt, queue, steer | Missing | no route; `POST /agents/:id/message` (`annex-server.ts:1710-1745`) exists but the desktop controller never calls it |
| Permission prompts on the desktop controller | Missing | queued on the satellite (`chat-runtime.ts:885-930`), but the controller ignores `permission:request` and `pendingPermissions` |
| Questions (`waiting_input`) | Missing | no Annex route reaches `runtime.answerQuestion` (`chat-runtime.ts:689`) |
| Model / effort, slash commands, runtime switch | Missing | no routes; `/clear` special case lives only in `chat-handlers.ts:150` |
| Rich content (images, media) | Missing | `READ_MEDIA` is local only (`chat-handlers.ts:184-190`) |
| Protocol versioning | Risk | `annex-client.ts:595` disconnects on any `protocolVersion` mismatch, so a version bump strands every older satellite |
| Tests | Thin | only status push is covered (`annex-server.test.ts:3003`, `:3066`); no chat in `e2e/annex-v2` |

## Children

Each child is independently shippable; the order is the suggested landing order.

- [ ] #2391 [MEDIUM] Interim: placeholder naming the satellite instead of a blank terminal (ship first)
- [ ] #2394 [HIGH] `agent:kill` and remote delete never stop a chat agent (live bug, independent)
- [ ] #2392 [MEDIUM] Protocol: forward `chat:event`, transcript and sessions backfill with seq, additive `capabilities` instead of a version bump
- [ ] #2393 [MEDIUM] Remote ChatView rendering (chatStore backend switch, ChatHistory, Needs you lands in chat)
- [ ] #2395 [MEDIUM] Send, steer, queue and interrupt routing (shared send helper with `/clear`)
- [ ] #2396 [MEDIUM] Answer remote chat permissions and questions from the controller
- [ ] #2397 [MEDIUM] Session controls: model/effort, level, compact, runtime switch, wake runtime shown for sleeping agents
- [ ] #2398 [LOW] Rich content over Annex: media by ref, attachments as bytes, no controller-local path reads
- [ ] #2399 [MEDIUM] Unit tests and fake-CLI dual-instance E2E (no paid prompts)
- [ ] #2400 [LOW] iOS parity: document chat routes, settle auth scope, chat-aware history

## Related

- #2211 chat status push (closed, the only chat-over-Annex work so far)
- #2324 terminal replay has no seq (same race shape the chat backfill must avoid)
- #2381 Annex terminal backfill sizing
- #1924 pending permissions cleared only when the Annex server runs
- #1121 hook status reliability and permission UX
- #2349 rich chat content epic (child 7 depends on it)
- #934 snapshot versioning/sequencing
- #1088 permission approvals UX
title: [MEDIUM] Epic: native chat over desktop-to-desktop Annex
